## Problem and example

Describe the concrete workflow that needs improvement and its current behavior.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the smallest useful change, affected package(s) and alternatives considered.

## Acceptance criteria

Describe how a contributor can verify success, including failure behavior and compatibility.

## Existing plan

Link the related TODO/issue. Note any architecture, schema, trust or approval boundary. A proposal does not automatically authorize deferred work or publication.
